explanation.summary: You are on a health-related website. 6 known trackers from 5 companies (Google, Meta, Criteo, Hotjar, …) received information about your visit. Privacy grade: F (0/100).

items.text: Google counts visits and measures how people use the site (pages viewed, time spent). It is usually used for statistics.
Google builds an advertising profile of you. It records which pages you visit so that ads can follow you to other websites. It also stored a cookie in your browser.
Meta builds an advertising profile of you. It records which pages you visit so that ads can follow you to other websites.
Criteo builds an advertising profile of you. It records which pages you visit so that ads can follow you to other websites. It also stored a cookie in your browser.
Hotjar can record your mouse movements, clicks and scrolling, and sometimes what you type, so the site owner can replay your visit like a video. It also stored a cookie in your browser.
Xandr (Microsoft) builds an advertising profile of you. It records which pages you visit so that ads can follow you to other websites.

warnings: Contextual anomaly: this is a health-related website, yet 5 advertising, social, recording or fingerprinting services are present. Information about what you read here may be linked to your advertising profile. This is a serious privacy concern.
